artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan for the write-time record-versioning hook: hook, fixture test, dual-surface bare registration plus manifest wiring, doc truth-up, deploy and full-gate confirmation.

memory_candidates.content: When planning a write-time PreToolUse guard hook that consumes a shared BLOCKING/ADVISORY pattern library, measure the live repo's ADVISORY count with the sibling repo-wide lint BEFORE deciding the hook's advisory-tier posture. In this repo the record-versioning lint reports 3 BLOCKING but 809 ADVISORY findings outside specs/**, which converts the abstract argument 'advisory noise at write time trains users to ignore the hook' into a measured fact. The same measurement doubles as a pre-change attribution baseline so the implementer does not mistake pre-existing corpus debt for a hook-introduced regression.
